blocks.content: The Earth rotates from west to east, so places east of Greenwich are ahead of Greenwich time and those to the west are behind it.

rows: Decreases towards poles, zero at poles
Calculates local time and time zones

items: The Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N) passes through 8 Indian states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
IST is 5 hours 30 minutes ahead of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT/UTC).
Distance between lines of longitude is maximum at the Equator (~111 km) and converges to zero at the poles.
The International Date Line zigzags to avoid landmasses so political boundaries remain within a single calendar day.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Latitudes are parallel circles running east-west from the Equator (0°) to the Poles (90° N/S).
Longitudes are semi-circles running from the North Pole to the South Pole, anchored by the Prime Meridian (0°) in Greenwich.
The Earth rotates 360° in 24 hours, establishing a rate of 15° per hour or 1° every 4 minutes.
Indian Standard Time (IST) is calculated from the 82°30' E longitude passing through Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh.
The International Date Line roughly follows the 180° meridian where calendar days change upon crossing.
